correctness.rationale: Inspected frozen RESULT.md SHA c1ab9d6f70439b7dda1eda2f37dc44065fa38039 and code verify.py SHA cdb127e9b209bc1713cfa87e849091648f7d739f. Unit-edge tetrahedron with face normals n_i·n_j=−1/3 has projected area A(u)=√3/8 Σ|u·n_i|, perimeter P(u)=Σ_{i<j}1_{(u·n_i)(u·n_j)<0}√(1−(u·e_ij)^2) over six silhouette edges. Splitting the sphere into sign sectors and integrating polar angle yields E[AP]=4√3/(3π)+(2/π)∫₀^atan√2(1+sin²t)/√(2+sin²t)dt. Algebraic decomposition gives the stated 2E−F incomplete elliptic combination; E A=√3/4, E P=3 atan√2. The source certificate uses exact Fraction interval arithmetic, enclosing sqrt2,sqrt3,π,θ and the n≤14 binomial expansion with bounded alternating remainder ≤5/3^16, so -0.0004<cov<-0.0003 independent of float rounding. Separately recomputed high-precision quadrature and mpmath elliptic functions: E[AP]=1.24063482223759045867… and cov=-0.00035786769230333175…, consistent with the rational certificate. Numerical calculation alone does not prove the exact sign; the inspected exact interval construction does.
